title: EducatesLocalMirrors
description: The registry mirrors every local cluster needs, declared once in mirrors.yaml in the CLI data home. 'educates local cluster create' and 'educates local cluster start' create a declared mirror whose container is missing, then link every mirror container that exists into every node of the cluster. 'educates local mirror deploy' records a mirror in this file, creating it, and 'educates local mirror delete' removes it, keeping the rest of the file, comments included, as it was. The file can also be edited by hand.

apiVersion.description: API version of the configuration kind. Always cli.educates.dev/v1alpha1.

registryMirrors.description: Pull-through cache registries every local cluster pulls through, reducing repeated pulls from upstream registries. Each mirror runs in one container every local cluster shares. The always-on localhost:5001 registry is implicit and not listed here.

mirror.description: Upstream registry host to mirror, for example docker.io or ghcr.io. A mirror is declared once.

url.description: URL of the registry the mirror proxies to. Defaults to the mirror host.

username.description: Username for authenticating to the upstream registry.

password.description: Password for authenticating to the upstream registry.
